validation.protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by SUBJECT across 2 wearers: the held-out person's data is never in training, so the winner is chosen for robustness across people rather than for within-subject fit
validation.note: Windows overlap, so grouping by recording is required; a random window split would leak and inflate scores.

cost_controls.note: Stage A1 screened every setup on 50 % of the deduped windows with cheap probes; only the shortlist was probed on full data. A1 rows are in 'screen' and are NOT comparable with 'sweep' rows.

confound.warning: Each active gesture in this dataset is a single continuous take, so label is confounded with electrode state and wall-clock block. Compare any score against dc_only_control before reading it as gesture recognition. See docs/EDA.md.
